name: AMC_2022_23
description: American Mathematics Competition problems from the 2022-23 academic year, consisting of multiple-choice mathematics competition problems designed for high school students. These problems require advanced mathematical reasoning, problem-solving strategies, and mathematical knowledge covering topics like algebra, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics. The benchmark is derived from the official AMC competitions sponsored by the Mathematical Association of America.
reputation: Derived from official AMC 10/12 competition problems for the 2022-23 academic year; used as a challenging math reasoning benchmark for LLMs; harder than standard school-level math but below AIME difficulty
notes: Combines AMC 10A, 10B, 12A, 12B problems from the 2022-23 competition year. AMC problems are 30 questions each, 5-choice multiple choice, tested over 75 minutes. Difficulty ranges from moderate to challenging for high school students. Commonly used with AIME as a tiered math evaluation. Top scorers qualify for AIME.
